KXDWTSFINALS-31DEC26-TAT.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early when the contestant qualifies for the finale, is eliminated, withdraws, or is disqualified before qualifying.
KXDWTSFINALS-31DEC26-TAT.rules_primary: If Tatyana Ali qualifies for the finale of Dancing with the Stars Season 35 after market issuance and before Dec 31, 2026 at 10am EST, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXDWTSFINALS-31DEC26-TAT.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Qualification for the finale must be officially announced or made evident through the program broadcast, official website, verified social media, or official press releases. Qualification counts regardless of whether the contestant subsequently appears in the finale.
Each contestant who qualifies resolves to Yes. Multiple contestants can resolve to Yes, and payouts are not divided among finalists.
The qualification deadline is Dec 31, 2026 at 10am EST. The competition is Dancing with the Stars Season 35; other editions and seasons do not count.

Payout criteria
Official qualification by audience vote, judges' decision, challenge result, or rules-based advancement counts, including automatic advancement caused by another contestant's withdrawal or elimination.
Initial qualification governs, even if the contestant is subsequently disqualified, removed, or withdraws.
Each named contestant is tracked across partner changes.

Doesn't count for payout
Elimination, withdrawal, or disqualification before qualification resolves to No. A later return requires a separate contract iteration.
Temporary immunity, non-elimination status, rumors, leaks, or appearing as a guest or in a recap without qualification do not count.
No qualification before the deadline, or a season ending or being cancelled without official qualification, resolves to No.
If a contestant can no longer participate due to their death, the market resolves to the last fair price determined by the Exchange.

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with Dancing with the Stars. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

KXNFLLASTTOWIN-27-WAS.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early once the last winless team or tied teams can be unconditionally determined.
KXNFLLASTTOWIN-27-WAS.rules_primary: If Washington remains winless the longest, measured by the Pro Football week of its first win, with teams that finish winless ranked last in the 2026-27 Pro Football regular season, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXNFLLASTTOWIN-27-WAS.rules_secondary:
First win: This market resolves based on the team that remains winless the longest in the 2026-27 Pro Football regular season, measured by the Pro Football week of its first win, rather than the exact date or time. A tied game does not count as a win.
Same-week first wins: If the last remaining winless teams record their first wins in the same NFL week, they are considered tied for this market, even if one wins on Thursday and another on Sunday of that week.
Winless season: A team that finishes the regular season without a win ranks after every team that records a win. If multiple teams finish the regular season winless, those teams are considered tied for this market.
Tie resolution: If N teams are tied for last, Yes positions on each tied team pay $1/N, rounded down to the nearest cent, and No positions pay $1 minus the Yes payout. Other teams resolve to No.

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the National Football League. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.
